name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is Qwen's open-weight release under the Qwen3.8 architecture and an early preview of the Qwen4 architecture. Qwen identifies Qwen3.8-Flash as the production QwenCloud version based on this model.

details.name: parameter_count
details.other_info: 125B total parameters, plus 51B n-gram embedding and 4B MTP parameters.

page_notice.markdown: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is available as an open-weight multimodal model with 262K native context. Qwen3.8-Flash is the production QwenCloud version based on it and is coming soon at announced rates of $0.16 per 1M input tokens and $0.47 per 1M output tokens. [View the Hugging Face model card](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next).

sources.notes: ModelScope announces an upcoming open release named Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and describes it as the next-generation architecture powering Qwen4.
Official Qwen model card publishes the open-weight model, multimodal interface, license, parameter counts, context length, and Qwen3.8-Flash production relationship.

verification.notes: Open-weight release and technical details verified against the official Hugging Face model card; QwenCloud production availability remains pending.
